name: Ore ga ♀ de Kanojo ga ♂ ni!? Kiyowa Bishounen to Kanpeki Bishoujo ga Change! ~Dasanaide! Jibun no Karada de Ninshin Saserarete Icchau!~
original_name: 俺が♀で彼女が♂に!? 気弱美少年と完璧美少女がChange！ ～出さないで！自分のカラダで妊娠させられてイっちゃう！～
source:
An X-rated story about a platonic boy and girl who swap bodies and awaken their desires!

* Sweet love experienced from a guy's POV from inside a girl
Recommended for fans of the feminization genre or who want to explore it.

* Situations and cosplay galore, from shower to maid play
"But I'm the guy!" The protagonist bends to his friend's demands in a strange role reversal.

* Friends become lovers and make a baby together
Hot unprotected sex eventually leads to pregnancy and then H emotions run deepcore!
